name: The Flash (Barry Allen)
summary: The fastest man alive, still late for everything. Barry Allen, a police scientist struck by lightning in his lab, is the Flash whose 1956 debut kicked off comics' Silver Age.
origin: Barry Allen is the fastest man alive and still somehow late for everything, which is half his charm. Robert Kanigher and Carmine Infantino gave DC a brand-new Flash in Showcase #4 in 1956, and that issue usually gets the credit for kicking off comics' Silver Age. Barry was a police forensic scientist working late when lightning smashed through his lab and soaked him in chemicals, leaving him able to run, think and react at incredible speeds. Later writers tied his gifts to the Speed Force, an energy field all speedsters tap into. He came after Jay Garrick and before Wally West, and the way he gave his life during Crisis on Infinite Earths is still one of DC's biggest moments.
powers: Draws power from the Speed Force

storyline.title: Lightning and chemicals
storyline.beat: Police scientist Barry Allen is struck by lightning and doused in chemicals in Showcase #4, gaining super speed. The issue is traditionally seen as the start of comics' Silver Age.

storyline.title: Meeting Jay Garrick
storyline.beat: Barry vibrates into a parallel Earth and meets Jay Garrick, the Golden Age Flash, introducing DC's multiverse.

storyline.title: Losing Iris
storyline.beat: The Reverse-Flash murders Barry's wife Iris. Years later Barry kills Thawne to save his new fiancée and stands trial for it.

storyline.title: The ultimate sacrifice
storyline.beat: In Crisis on Infinite Earths, Barry runs himself out of existence to destroy the Anti-Monitor's weapon, saving reality.

storyline.title: Back from the Speed Force
storyline.beat: After more than 20 years away, Barry returns in Final Crisis and Flash: Rebirth.

storyline.title: Breaking time
storyline.beat: Barry travels back to save his mother and creates a nightmare timeline. Fixing it reshapes the whole DC universe into the New 52.

gossip.text: Barry Allen was the first Flash.
gossip.truth: Jay Garrick was the first Flash in 1940. Barry arrived in 1956.

gossip.text: Barry was named after two talk-show hosts, Barry Gray and Steve Allen.
Barry stayed dead for 23 real-world years, and Wally West kept the Flash name running the whole time.
In Flash of Two Worlds, Barry had read about Jay Garrick in comic books before meeting him.
Grant Gustin played Barry in The Flash TV series for nine seasons, from 2014 to 2023.

quiz.why: He works as a police scientist.

quiz.q: In which 1985 event did Barry sacrifice himself?

theme.tagline: Late for everything, despite being the fastest.

timeline.title: Lightning in Showcase
timeline.note: Showcase #4 introduces police chemist Barry Allen, and his debut is widely credited with starting the Silver Age.

timeline.title: Flash of Two Worlds
timeline.note: Barry vibrates onto a parallel Earth and meets Golden Age Flash Jay Garrick. The DC multiverse starts here.

timeline.title: Meet Professor Zoom
timeline.note: The Flash #139 introduces Eobard Thawne, a man from the future who copies Barry's speed for evil.

timeline.title: Crisis sacrifice
timeline.note: Barry runs himself out of existence wrecking the Anti-Monitor's cannon in Crisis on Infinite Earths #8.

timeline.title: Prime-time sprinter
timeline.note: John Wesley Shipp races through a big-budget CBS live-action series in a muscled red suit.

timeline.title: Out of the Speed Force
timeline.note: After more than two decades gone, Barry comes racing back into the DCU during Final Crisis.

timeline.title: Flashpoint
timeline.note: Barry tries to save his mother, breaks the timeline, and sets up the whole New 52 reboot.

timeline.title: The CW years
timeline.note: Grant Gustin plays Barry for nine seasons on The CW, anchoring a whole linked TV universe.
